correctness.rationale: The finite claim follows from exact semigroup factorization of terminal mass, strictly positive pulse-adjoint trait gradients (Metzler positive forcing), preservation of the sign of the initial mutation gradient, and a symmetric Dirichlet identity; the reflecting-continuum proof replaces graph gradients by Neumann/Dirichlet parabolic comparison. The n=2 exponential formula and both zero-gradient boundaries agree. All strict signs hold at positive mutation rates and nonzero nonnegative pulse profiles; computation only checks identities.

value.rationale: Complete and robust contact-window placement criterion under all nonnegative pulse intensities: opposite exact optima for low- and high-infectivity enriched initial profiles, neutral outcome for uniform profile, for every finite ladder and a bounded reflecting continuum. This addresses a natural timing question raised by mutation/intervention coevolution and is not an arbitrary small parameter refinement. The result is restricted to linearized finite-horizon infected burden and is not a policy prescription for the nonlinear SIR system.
